plugin.name: Google Workspace
plugin.description: Google Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Calendar and Docs, with polling triggers for new rows and new emails.
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: googleSheets
nodes.description: Read, append and update rows in Google Sheets
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}: {{resource}}

options.name: Service Account
options.description: A service account key; share files with its email

options.name: OAuth2
options.description: Act as a Google user: Connect the credential, or give it a refresh token

options.name: Document
options.description: A spreadsheet file

options.name: Sheet Within Document
options.description: Rows of one sheet (tab)

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a spreadsheet

options.name: Append or Update Row
options.description: Append a new row or update an existing one (upsert)
options.action: Append or update row in sheet

options.name: Append Row
options.description: Create a new row in a sheet

options.name: Clear
options.description: Delete all the contents of a sheet

options.name: Get Row(s)
options.description: Retrieve one or more rows from a sheet

options.name: Update Row
options.description: Update an existing row in a sheet

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title of the new spreadsheet

properties.name: sheetsUi
properties.description: Sheets (tabs) to create; Google adds one called Sheet1 when empty

values.name: title
values.description: Name of the sheet

properties.name: documentId
properties.description: Spreadsheet to use. An expression may also give its ID or URL.

properties.name: sheetName
properties.description: Sheet (tab) in the document; empty means the first one

properties.name: keepFirstRow
properties.description: Whether to keep the header row and clear only the data

options.name: Map Automatically
options.description: Use the input fields whose names match column names

options.name: Map Each Column Manually
options.description: Set the value of each column below

properties.name: columnToMatchOn
properties.description: Column used to find the row to update. With Map Automatically the item's field of the same name gives the value.

properties.name: valueToMatchOn
properties.displayName: Value of Column to Match On
properties.description: Rows whose Column to Match On holds this value are updated

values.name: fieldId
values.description: Column name, as in the header row

properties.name: filtersUI
properties.description: Return only rows where the column equals the value; no filters return every row

options.name: AND
options.description: Rows must match every filter

options.name: OR
options.description: Rows must match at least one filter

nodes.toolDescription: Work with rows of a Google Sheets spreadsheet whose first row holds column names. operation=read returns rows as objects keyed by column name plus row_number, optionally filtered by filtersUI (column = value); append adds a row from the item's fields (keys matching column names); appendOrUpdate and update find the row whose columnToMatchOn equals the item's value for that column. Needs documentId (spreadsheet ID or URL) and sheetName (tab title).

credentialTypes.name: googleApi
credentialTypes.description: A service account key. Share spreadsheets, files and calendars with the service account's email; Gmail needs domain-wide delegation (Impersonate a User).

properties.name: email
properties.description: client_email from the JSON key file

properties.name: privateKey
properties.description: private_key from the JSON key file. Escaped \n sequences and a pasted line without newlines both work, and so does the whole JSON key file.

properties.name: delegatedEmail
properties.description: Optional. Act as this Workspace user through domain-wide delegation; required for Gmail.

properties.name: tokenUrl
properties.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Leave empty for Google. When set, it replaces the host of every Google API and keeps the paths (/v4/spreadsheets…, /gmail/v1/…, /drive/v3/…, /calendar/v3/…, /v1/documents…), e.g. for a proxy or a test double.

credentialTypes.name: googleOAuth2Api
credentialTypes.description: Sign in with Google: create an OAuth client (Web application) in Google Cloud, add the redirect URL shown below, then Connect. A refresh token obtained elsewhere (OAuth Playground, gcloud) works too.

properties.name: accessTokenUrl
properties.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Space-separated scopes asked for at Connect. Trim it to the APIs your workflows use; openid and email show who connected.

properties.name: refreshToken
properties.description: Optional: only when not using Connect. A refresh token for this client with the scopes you need (see the plugin README).

properties.name: baseUrl
properties.description: Leave empty for Google. When set, it replaces the host of every Google API and keeps the paths (/v4/spreadsheets…, /gmail/v1/…, /drive/v3/…, /calendar/v3/…, /v1/documents…), e.g. for a proxy or a test double.
